meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Level energies are the NIST ASD values (the papers use the same Van Kleef & Klinkenberg 1961 energies). Transitions: 129 lines of Quinet et al. 2006 Table 5 (16 upper levels) plus Kurucz-listed Kwiatkowski 1984 lines not in that table. Order of preference for A_s: (1) measured branching fraction x measured lifetime of Ivarsson et al. 2003 as quoted by Quinet et al. (method 'compilation'), (2) Kwiatkowski et al. 1984 log gf as listed by Kurucz (method 'compilation', converted with A = 0.66702 sigma^2 gf / (2J'+1), sigma in cm-1 from the NIST-equal level energies), (3) semi-empirical value of Quinet et al. (calculated branching fraction x measured lifetime, method 'theory'). All A_s are per-line Einstein coefficients, derived from the printed gA or log gf; no uncertainties are printed for individual lines. Wavelengths in labels are air wavelengths computed from the level energies. Isotope abundances are in percent; abundance_unc is the NIST uncertainty in percent.
